about_the_game:
Become a Splitgate 2 Founder

Want to become a Splitgate 2 founder? The Aces Founder's Pack comes with all of the cosmetic content in each faction Founder's Pack, including six character skins, nine weapon skins, two emotes, three banners, three charms, and 2000 Splitcoin.

Aces Founder's Pack includes:

- 6 character skins

- 9 weapon skins

- 2 emotes

- 3 banners

- 3 charms

- 2000 Splitcoin

Splitcoin is the in-game currency that can be used to obtain in-game content for use in Splitgate 2.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 / Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
